top_issues: Home: The tier breakdown legend directly below the main balance bar uses stacked text with colored square swatches that add visual clutter without matching the sleek bar presentation.
Home: Dual representation of USDC (both in the summary balance bar and in the BALANCES list below) creates immediate cognitive redundancy.
Home: Floating badge 'hub' uses a washed-out lavender chip that looks like an unstyled developer tag rather than deliberate metadata.
fixes: Home: Convert the On-chain / Reserve / Accounts legend into an inline horizontal caption beneath the bar with mono numeric values and 6px circular dots instead of squircle swatches.
Home: Replace the 'hub' pill styling with a neutral low-contrast badge (`background: rgba(15,23,42,0.04); color: #64748b; font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px`).
Home: Align the right-hand arrow chevron on the USDC row with the outer padding grid to match the Accounts card edge.

top_issues: Home bottom: The bottom tab bar clips awkwardly over the 'All activity' link and bottom card margin, lacking a dedicated background blur/scrim separation.
Home bottom: Recent activity rows inside the card repeat the same micro-status dots (settled, updated, created) at uneven horizontal coordinates relative to amounts.
Home bottom: The 'Open account' button is styled as a grey outline box that feels heavy and competes with the list hierarchy above it.
fixes: Home bottom: Add `padding-bottom: calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))` to the scroll container so 'All activity' clears the fixed bottom tab bar completely.
Home bottom: Standardize the recent activity item layout so the status text (`• settled`) is pinned directly below the right-aligned amount rather than floating on its own line baseline.
Home bottom: Make 'Open account' a subtle text-button with icon (`color: #6E7CFF; background: transparent; border: none; padding: 8px 0`) aligned flush-left.

top_issues: Pay: Full unformatted 42-character hex address in the 'To' card wraps across two lines and degrades the calm fintech aesthetic with raw crypto noise.
Pay: The 'This payment' mini visual scale bar is so small (single black dot/dash) that the visceral scale principle becomes unreadable and looks like a rendering artifact.
Pay: 'Arrives Instantly' and 'Delivery Instant Change' duplicate the same concept across two adjacent rows in the receipt summary.
fixes: Pay: Truncate the destination address to middle-ellipsis (`0x499d...f2bd`) in light 12px mono with a subtle copy icon.
Pay: Under 'This payment', set a minimum visible bar width of 3px with a subtle vertical guide connecting down to the account capacity bar to make relative scale obvious.
Pay: Consolidate 'Arrives' and 'Delivery' into a single row: label 'Delivery', value 'Instant · 0.000050 USDC fee', with 'Change' aligned right.

top_issues: Receipt: A stray stray vertical blue tick mark appears on the left margin outside the card boundary near the bottom sheet edge.
Receipt: 'in 3006 ms' in mint green draws disproportionate attention to a slow 3-second roundtrip that should be understated or omitted once settled.
Receipt: The visceral value bar is absent on the receipt modal, missing an opportunity to show the deducted tranche from the bilateral line.
fixes: Receipt: Eliminate the stray pixel artifact positioned at `left: ~16px` outside the sheet container.
Receipt: Style the settlement latency as muted secondary text (`color: #64748b; font-size: 13px`) instead of active positive mint green.
Receipt: Place a mini bilateral capacity bar below '25.00 USDC' showing the updated post-settlement balance.

top_issues: Receipt bottom: Same stray visual blue artifact appears on the left gutter against the sheet border.
Receipt bottom: Sheet scrim over the background causes low contrast and visual mud in light mode, making background numbers look dirty rather than gently receding.
Receipt bottom: Action button 'Done' sits too close to the bottom viewport edge, risking home-indicator conflict on iOS.
fixes: Receipt bottom: Increase sheet background scrim to `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)` for clean separation from the light canvas.
Receipt bottom: Add `margin-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))` to the 'Done' button container.
Receipt bottom: Remove the extraneous absolute-positioned blue tick dot artifact from the viewport stylesheet.

top_issues: Receive: QR code card sits with harsh stark margins and no token/brand iconography, looking like an unstyled SVG block.
Receive: 'Copy xln:// app link' text link sits orphaned below primary pill buttons with no tap target visual cues.
Receive: Inbound room capacity is represented by a plain blue/purple gradient bar under 0.00 without scale labels or ticks.
fixes: Receive: Embed a centered 24px USDC coin badge in the middle of the QR code with an 8px white rounded mask.
Receive: Group the three share actions into a clean horizontal 3-column button segment or place the deep-link in a standard secondary row inside the share card.
Receive: Add zero-notch marker and inbound headroom marker to the bar beneath the amount input field.

top_issues: Receive bottom: Top half of QR code is severely truncated when scrolling down to reveal Entity ID card.
Receive bottom: Full raw Entity ID is displayed as an uncopyable 64-character text block with wrapping, intimidating non-technical users.
Receive bottom: Redundant explanatory copy across both 'SHARE' and 'YOUR ENTITY ID' cards introduces unnecessary reading fatigue.
fixes: Receive bottom: Keep QR code compact (180x180px) so the full receive card, amount, and quick-actions fit into one single unscrollable mobile screen.
Receive bottom: Display Entity ID in a monospaced input-like chip with an explicit one-tap copy button and middle truncation (`0xf581...476b`).
Receive bottom: Reduce the helper body text from 3 sentences to 1 concise sentence: 'Payments to this ID settle instantly through your bilateral routes.'

top_issues: Swap: Visceral scale bar is completely missing from both the 'You pay' and 'You receive' cards, breaking the core product principle.
Swap: The 'Swap' primary submit button uses an excessively faint disabled purple (`#b4bbfd`) with white text that fails WCAG AA contrast (1.8:1 ratio).
Swap: Segmented control 'Same network / Across networks' sits awkwardly in the header bar instead of inline with the swap flow.
fixes: Swap: Render the proportional 1px=$N bar under both payment and receive fields to demonstrate remaining bilateral balance.
Swap: Change the inactive Swap CTA style to `background: rgba(110, 124, 255, 0.12); color: #6E7CFF; cursor: not-allowed` for clean legible hierarchy.
Swap: Move network mode pills into a full-width segmented control bar below the top navigation header.

top_issues: Account: The four-color legend (`collateral`, `credit line`, `owed`, `in flight`) is placed high above the card and disconnected from the actual bar it describes.
Account: The 'Show 2 empty lanes · WETH, USDT' link looks like an unstyled inline hyperlink stranded between two white cards.
Account: Bottom 'THIS ACCOUNT' card gets cut off by the fixed bottom tab bar without adequate scroll padding.
fixes: Account: Move the color swatch legend inside the card directly below the bilateral bar as micro-subtitles.
Account: Turn 'Show 2 empty lanes' into a clean rounded cell with a subtle disclosure chevron and secondary counter pill.
Account: Add `padding-bottom: 96px` to the scrollable view so all account metadata and verification notices are fully readable above the tab bar.

top_issues: Activity: Filter pills at the top have inconsistent pill styles (selected 'All' is filled lavender, while others have faint borders) that clip slightly on the right edge.
Activity: The small blue tick mark artifact appears again at the left edge of the 'Sent' item row.
Activity: Green visceral value bar under '+10,000.00 USDC' is prominent, but the '-25.00 USDC' bar is invisible/1px wide, making the list look misaligned.
fixes: Activity: Fix the horizontal filter bar to `overflow-x: auto; padding-right: 16px` with custom scroll padding so chips don't crop harshly.
Activity: Audit CSS pseudo-elements (`::before`) on activity items to remove the stray 2x4px blue dot on item 0.
Activity: Provide a minimum visual bar track (e.g. 1px light gray background track with 2px colored indicator) so low amounts register visually without looking broken.

top_issues: Activity detail: The background activity list behind the sheet still exhibits the left blue dot rendering artifact.
Activity detail: 'Frames: 5 committed entries' row uses bold weight that competes with the primary amount above it.
Activity detail: Sheet close 'x' icon is very small and close to the sheet margin, offering a sub-standard mobile tap target (<32px).
fixes: Activity detail: Enlarge the sheet close button tap target to 44x44px with a subtle hover/active circle state.
Activity detail: Change '5 committed entries' font weight from 600 to 500 tabular mono to match the Frame `#40` row above it.
Activity detail: Add a compact bilateral delta visualization showing how this payment moved the balance needle on Hub One.

top_issues: Settings: Slider handle track for 'Dollars per pixel' uses inconsistent colors (indigo left, thin gray right) without explicit step notches matching the pills below.
Settings: Quick-select preset pills (`Auto`, `$1`, `$2`, etc.) wrap unevenly and create tap crowding on mobile widths.
Settings: Theme toggle uses button-style outline pills inside a list row rather than standard iOS-style segmented control.
fixes: Settings: Align scale preset pills to a 4-column grid or horizontal scroll strip with 8px uniform gap.
Settings: Replace slider with a stepped discrete track that snaps directly to the defined scale stops.
Settings: Standardize the Theme selector into a full iOS-style native segmented control (`height: 36px; background: #F1F5F9; border-radius: 8px`).

top_issues: Settings bottom: The 'AT THIS SCALE' diagnostic card has exceptional educational value for visceral scaling, but is buried at the bottom of a technical runtime screen.
Settings bottom: Vault buttons ('Reveal recovery phrase', 'Lock') sit directly adjacent with identical weight, creating equal visual affordance for high-risk vs routine actions.
Settings bottom: Runtime ID displays a raw 64-character hex address string with truncation/overflow risk on smaller viewports.
fixes: Settings bottom: Move the 'AT THIS SCALE' ruler card directly underneath the scale slider on the upper half of Settings.
Settings bottom: Distinguish Vault actions by styling 'Lock' as a secondary outline and 'Reveal recovery phrase' behind an explicit security gate/disclosure row.
Settings bottom: Format Runtime ID in a monospaced truncated badge with one-tap copy confirmation.

overall.verdict: The mobile light theme demonstrates exceptional clarity and rigorous architectural intent with its one-scale visceral bars and instant provable state cues. However, it suffers from crypto-native visual clutter (raw 64-character hashes, uncurated metadata chips) and recurring frontend rendering artifacts like stray blue ticks and bottom-tab scroll overlaps.
priority_fixes: Fix viewport scroll container padding across all screens (`padding-bottom: 96px`) to prevent bottom tab bars and floating sheets from truncating actions and metadata.
Eliminate the stray absolute blue tick/pseudo-element rendering bug present on the left margins of Activity, Receipt, and Pay views.
Truncate all raw 42/64-character hexadecimal IDs (destination addresses, runtime IDs, proofs) to middle-ellipses (`0x1234...abcd`) with native copy interactions.
Unify visceral value bars on zero/small balances with a permanent 1px background track so small payments ($25) do not render as invisible 0.5px slivers.
Fix disabled button color contrast on Swap and secondary action buttons to meet minimum WCAG AA 4.5:1 legibility standards in light mode.
